# @molgpu/nn public API — generated by scripts/check-hardening.mjs --update

## .

Activation
  export type Activation = "none" | "gelu";
BackboneSource
  export interface BackboneSource { readonly positions: ArrayLike<number>; readonly topology: { readonly atoms: { readonly count: number; readonly name: readonly string[]; readonly residue: ArrayLike<number> }; readonly residues: { readonly count: number; readonly chain: ArrayLike<number>; readonly labelSeq: ArrayLike<number>; readonly comp: readonly string[]; readonly polymer: readonly string[] }; readonly chains: { readonly model: ArrayLike<number> } } }
GpuTensor
  export interface GpuTensor { readonly buffer: GPUBuffer; readonly shape: readonly number[]; readonly dtype: "f32" | "u32"; /** True when the runtime destroys the buffer on `release` or `destroy`. */ readonly owned: boolean }
IndexTensor
  export interface IndexTensor { readonly shape: readonly number[]; readonly data: Uint32Array }
LAYER_NORM_EPS
  export const LAYER_NORM_EPS = 0.00001;
LayoutMatrix
  export interface LayoutMatrix { /** Checkpoint tensor name. */ readonly name: string; readonly shape: readonly [number, number] }
LayoutStage
  export interface LayoutStage { readonly label: string; readonly matrices: readonly LayoutMatrix[] }
LayoutStep
  export interface LayoutStep { readonly stage: string; /** Layer within the stage, or -1. */ readonly layer: number; readonly weights: readonly string[] }
ModelLayout
  export interface ModelLayout { readonly stages: readonly LayoutStage[] }
NnRuntime
  export class NnRuntime { #private; readonly device: GPUDevice; constructor(device: GPUDevice); /** Upload a CPU tensor into a new owned buffer. */ upload(t: Tensor, label?: string): GpuTensor; /** A new owned f32 tensor of zeros (WebGPU zero-initializes buffers). */ zeros(shape: readonly number[], label?: string): GpuTensor; /** Upload row indices into a new owned buffer. */ uploadIndex(t: IndexTensor, label?: string): GpuTensor; /** Upload every named tensor, labelling each buffer with its name. */ uploadWeights(weights: ReadonlyMap<string, Tensor>): Map<string, GpuTensor>; /** View a caller-owned buffer as a tensor; the runtime never destroys it. */ wrap(buffer: GPUBuffer, shape: readonly number[], dtype?: "f32" | "u32"): GpuTensor; /** x Wᵀ + b with W in [out, in] layout and an optional fused GELU. */ linear(x: GpuTensor, w: GpuTensor, b?: GpuTensor, activation?: Activation): GpuTensor; /** LayerNorm over the last axis of x, or of x + residual. */ layerNorm(x: GpuTensor, gamma: GpuTensor, beta: GpuTensor, options?: { residual?: GpuTensor; eps?: number }): GpuTensor; /** Rows of x [R, C] at each index; indices must be below R (not checked on the GPU). */ gatherRows(x: GpuTensor, index: GpuTensor): GpuTensor; /** Sum of x [L, K, C] over K, weighted by mask [L, K], divided by scale. */ neighborSum(x: GpuTensor, options?: { mask?: GpuTensor; scale?: number }): GpuTensor; /** Log-softmax over the last axis. */ logSoftmax(x: GpuTensor): GpuTensor; /** Concatenate along the last axis; one side's leading dims must prefix the other's. */ concat(a: GpuTensor, b: GpuTensor): GpuTensor; /** mask * a + (1 - mask) * b, with one mask value per row of a. */ mix(a: GpuTensor, b: GpuTensor, mask: GpuTensor): GpuTensor; /** A new owned tensor holding x's current values, recorded in dispatch order. */ copy(x: GpuTensor, label?: string): GpuTensor; /** Submit the recorded dispatches. */ flush(): void; /** Flush, then copy a tensor back to the CPU. */ read(t: GpuTensor): Promise<Float32Array | Uint32Array>; /** Destroy owned tensors' buffers after flushing work that may read them. */ release(...tensors: GpuTensor[]): void; /** Flush and destroy every owned buffer; wrapped buffers are left alone. */ destroy(): void }

  export const PROTEIN_MPNN_ALPHABET = "ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWYX";

  export const PROTEIN_MPNN_ATOM_PAIRS: readonly string[];

ProteinMpnn
  export class ProteinMpnn { #private; readonly runtime: NnRuntime; readonly weights: ReadonlyMap<string, GpuTensor>; /** Encoder and decoder layers, counted from the checkpoint's weight names. */ readonly layers: { readonly encoder: number; readonly decoder: number }; constructor(runtime: NnRuntime, weights: ReadonlyMap<string, GpuTensor>); /** Featurize on the CPU, then run the three encoder layers on the GPU. */ encode(input: ProteinMpnnInput, options?: ProteinMpnnRunOptions): ProteinMpnnEncoding; /** [L, 21] log-probabilities of every amino acid at every position. */ decode(encoding: ProteinMpnnEncoding, visible: ProteinMpnnVisibility, sequence?: Uint8Array, options?: ProteinMpnnRunOptions): GpuTensor; /** Release an encoding's GPU tensors. */ release(encoding: ProteinMpnnEncoding): void }
ProteinMpnnEncoding
  export interface ProteinMpnnEncoding { readonly input: ProteinMpnnInput; readonly graph: ProteinMpnnGraph; /** [L, K] neighbour indices on the GPU. */ readonly neighbors: GpuTensor; /** [L, H] node embeddings after each encoder layer; the last is the encoder output. */ readonly layers: readonly GpuTensor[]; /** [L, K, H] edge embeddings after the last encoder layer. */ readonly edges: GpuTensor }
ProteinMpnnGraph
  export interface ProteinMpnnGraph { readonly length: number; /** Neighbours per residue, min(48, L); each residue is its own first neighbour. */ readonly k: number; /** [L, K] neighbour residue per edge, nearest first. */ readonly neighbors: Uint32Array; /** [L, K, 400] RBF features. */ readonly rbf: Float32Array; /** [L, K] positional class in 0..65. */ readonly positional: Uint32Array }
ProteinMpnnInput
  export interface ProteinMpnnInput { /** [L, 4, 3] coordinates of N, CA, C, O in Å. */ readonly backbone: Float32Array; /** Position along the chain; only differences within one chain matter. */ readonly residueIndex: Int32Array; /** Chain label per residue; residues with equal labels share a chain. */ readonly chain: Int32Array; /** Native amino acid per residue as an index into `PROTEIN_MPNN_ALPHABET`. */ readonly sequence: Uint8Array; /** Source residue row of each model position. */ readonly residues: Uint32Array }
ProteinMpnnRunOptions
  export interface ProteinMpnnRunOptions { /** Record every activation of the call into this trace (same runtime). */ readonly trace?: ProteinMpnnTrace }
ProteinMpnnStage
  export type ProteinMpnnStage = "features" | "encoder" | "sequence" | "decoder" | "output";
ProteinMpnnStep
  export interface ProteinMpnnStep { /** Position in the trace, from 0. */ readonly index: number; readonly stage: ProteinMpnnStage; /** Encoder or decoder layer from 0; -1 outside the layers. */ readonly layer: number; /** What the step computes, such as `"message W2"` or `"norm1"`. */ readonly name: string; /** Checkpoint tensors the step read, by state_dict name. */ readonly weights: readonly string[]; /** Shape of the activation the model computed: [L, C] or [L, K, C]. */ readonly shape: readonly number[]; /** * [L, C] values per residue: the activation itself, or for an [L, K, C] * edge activation its mean over the K neighbours. */ readonly values: GpuTensor }
ProteinMpnnTrace
  export class ProteinMpnnTrace { #private; readonly runtime: NnRuntime; constructor(runtime: NnRuntime); /** Recorded steps in forward-pass order. */ get steps(): readonly ProteinMpnnStep[]; /** Record x as the next step; called by `ProteinMpnn` while it runs. */ record(stage: ProteinMpnnStage, layer: number, name: string, weights: readonly string[], x: GpuTensor): void; /** CPU copies of every step's [L, C] values, in step order. */ read(): Promise<Float32Array[]>; /** Destroy every recorded buffer and empty the trace. */ release(): void }
ProteinMpnnVisibility
  export type ProteinMpnnVisibility = "none" | "all-but-self" | readonly number[];
